marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Tuesday.
marine.text:
Wind light becoming southeast 15 knots this evening then
diminishing to light Tuesday morning. Wind increasing to northwest 20 near noon
Tuesday and to northwest 30 Tuesday evening. Snow Tuesday. Fog patches forming overnight and dissipating

in snow. Temperatures minus 6 rising to minus 1 Tuesday
evening. <br/>
